## Method

- Chronological 60/40 training and holdout split.
- Stops and targets selected only from training data.
- Recorded MAE and MFE are used for exit simulation.
- When stop and target were both reachable, stop is counted first.
- Holdout, walk-forward, and Monte Carlo results determine status.

- No orders were submitted.
- No production settings were changed.
- No experts or alliances were promoted automatically.
